summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotating string-array decoder obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift-based decoder over a large constant array) and hex-mangled identifiers; visible tokens include `fd`, `w+`, `r+`, `rm`, and `../` consistent with filesystem I/O. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with hex-mangled locals to wrap the download-and-exec logic. The package's advertised purpose is a trivial test package whose main entry exports the string 'John' — the Bun runtime and 727KB opaque payload are unrelated to that declared purpose. On `npm install`, the opaque bundle is executed under an alien runtime that installers did not opt into, bypassing tooling that inspects only Node-resolved code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
